name: Manifora
tagline: Freight forwarding for people who resent freight forwarding.
positioning: Manifora is the usage-based logistics layer for enterprises that ship small-batch, high-touch goods and refuse to pretend a spreadsheet counts as software.

hero.h1: Small-batch logistics that behaves like grown-up software.
hero.sub: Manifora routes, tracks, and settles your fussiest shipments — the hand-packed, temperature-sensitive, one-of-a-kind stuff your ERP quietly hates. You pay for what you move, not for the privilege.

features.title: Manifests that write themselves
features.description: Stop retyping customs codes at 11pm. Manifora generates line-level manifests from your order data and flags the one that'll get held at the border.

features.title: Live lineage, not last-seen
features.description: Every artisanal unit gets a traceable chain of custody — origin, handler, temperature, and who dropped it. Auditors love it. So will you.

features.title: Carrier logic without the tantrums
features.description: We benchmark 400+ specialty carriers per lane and pick the one that won't crush your ceramics. You approve; we dispatch.

features.title: Billing you can actually explain
features.description: Usage-based charges reconcile to individual shipments. Finance gets one clean line item per lane instead of a mystery invoice.

testimonials.quote: We were coordinating small-batch spice imports across three continents in a shared inbox. Manifora replaced the inbox, the spreadsheet, and one very tired coordinator's coping mechanism.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Our old 3PL treated hand-blown glassware like gravel. Manifora's carrier scoring cut our breakage claims by two-thirds in a quarter. I stopped dreading the loss report.
testimonials.name: Elias Moreau

testimonials.quote: The part that sold procurement was the billing. Every charge maps to a shipment. No 'miscellaneous freight adjustments.' It's almost suspiciously honest.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For teams moving a few hundred specialty units a month.
For growing operations that move real freight and hate surprises.
For enterprises running multi-region, audited supply chains.

homepage.footerBlurb: Manifora is logistics infrastructure for goods that deserve better than a pallet and a prayer. Usage-based pricing, enterprise spine.
